verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer Autofix, which automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes, automates triage, and can create PRs with generated fixes. It also documents rule-based Alerts that act on their own by sending notifications, creating tickets, or calling webhooks, and the Sentry Agent can be assigned Linear issues. Missing for 10: detail on how users configure and control autonomous Seer runs (triggers, thresholds, approval gates), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that these background automations work as claimed.
